brief:
Incoming Ohio congressman Don Leonard, a former Republican professor, has made demands to House Democratic leadership regarding U.S. support for Israel, according to Zeteo. Leonard, who flipped a previously Republican seat in his state, has called for ending aid to Israel and has clashed with Democratic leadership including Hakeem Jeffries over the issue.

Leonard's positions mark a sharp departure from mainstream Democratic orthodoxy on Middle East policy. His election in a traditionally conservative district and subsequent advocacy on Gaza have thrust him into immediate conflict with party leadership as he prepares to take office.
dek: You’ve never met a Democrat like this before. Incoming Ohio congressman Don Leonard is making ultimatums to Hakeem Jeffries, getting threatened in return, and denouncing genocide in Gaza.
title: Ohio Democrat elected to Trump seat demands halt to Israel aid
